name: Same Sun Of Vermont Inc
old_description: Solar solutions for homes and businesses, designed to maximize energy generation, while looking good on your roof, garage, yard or other location.
about:
Same Sun of Vermont was founded in 2011 in Rutland, Vermont, by Marlene and Philip Allen. The couple, a former commercial real estate appraiser and fine art dealer, had installed a rooftop array on their own home and decided to turn their experience into a family-owned business. They opened a ground-level storefront with the goal of using American-made products and creating local jobs to establish solar energy as a “new normal” in the region.

The company designs and installs custom solar arrays for residential, commercial, and institutional clients, and also provides EV charging station installation, ongoing service, maintenance, and repair. In 2018 it expanded to a 3,000-square-foot facility on West Street that features a solar awning, battery storage, and a dual EV charger. The team includes a NABCEP-certified technical sales specialist, a master electrician, and dedicated installation crews.

Same Sun serves homeowners, businesses, schools, and non-profits across Vermont, New Hampshire, and New York. Project examples include installations for VMS Construction, The Royal Group, Otter Valley Union High School, Weston Priory, and the Tunbridge Solar array in Benson and Royalton, as well as numerous residential roof and ground mounts.

The Allens started the business to empower property owners to generate their own energy and to keep young Vermonters in the state with good-paying work. The company emphasizes attention to detail, superior customer service, and sourcing premium components to ensure long-term system performance.
